_meta.purpose: SSOT projection: the authoritative strategy taxonomy cluster (VOCAB B, 40, stored + human-reviewed + fail-closed) -> the creative avatar/scene bucket (VOCAB A, 12, from creative_category_cluster_map.json 'clusters'). Avatar and scene share the same 12 namespace, so one target value serves both. Consumers resolve-on-read via product_cluster_grouping; nothing is re-derived from product.category.
_meta.domain: the 40-cluster union of SCOUTING_CLUSTER_ORDER + catalog_product_type_truth CATALOG_PRODUCT_TYPE_TRUTH_MAPPINGS + P58_PRODUCT_TRUTH_OVERRIDES (invariant-tested to equal it exactly)
_meta.range: subset of the 12 creative clusters in creative_category_cluster_map.json 'clusters'
_meta.sentinel: generic_unclassified maps to null -> grouping REVIEW_REQUIRED (never guessed into a bucket)
_meta.owner_review_targets: strategy clusters with no native creative bucket; ratified defaults (owner may veto — this is data, not code): traditional_wellness->Beauty, sensitive_wellness->Beauty (BOSMAX flagship: MWCB/Bosmax Herbs — no Wellness/Health bucket exists in the 12; Beauty is the closest personal-care/wellness persona set), health_device->Electronics & Gadgets, craft_hobby->Office & Stationery, garden_care->Tools & Home Improvement, home_electrical->Tools & Home Improvement, home_lighting->Home & Living, household_pest_control->Home & Living
_meta.invariant: every domain cluster has exactly one entry; a new stored cluster with no entry is a loud CI failure, never a silent fallback
